note: Frames carry no biggerStudy field in format.ts (FrameSchema is strict); each committee frame's bigger study is in its note as 'biggerStudy: ...' until the field exists (requested).

lists.title: Hats
lists.note: Grammar: one hat, with 'a', lower case, at most 24 characters; reads after 'wearing', 'in' and 'with'. Every phrase fits the town and every office.
phrases: a top hat with a ribbon
a sun hat with a strap
a felt hat with a brim
a hat with a bell on top
a rain hat with a gutter
a hat with a clock on it
a hat with a spare brim

lists.title: Places a sign can stand by
lists.note: Grammar: a spot that reads after 'by', with 'the', lower case, at most 24 characters; spots any town has (no canal, jetty, motorway or lighthouse), so the list serves 'any' frames as well as the given governor frame.
phrases: the far end of the street

lists.title: Harmless complaints
lists.note: Grammar: a complaint as it follows 'says' or 'that', lower case, no full stop, no person named, at most 28 characters; about a thing, never about a person or a group.
phrases: the clock is a minute proud
the lampposts do not line up
a duck has taken a bench
the steps have one too many
the sun sets a bit early
the moon is behind the clock
the hill is uphill both ways

lists.title: Odd units
lists.note: Grammar: a distance in odd units, a number word or 'a' then things, lower case, at most 20 characters; reads after 'by' and before 'of pavement'.

lists.title: Things that could take a new name
lists.note: Grammar: one thing any town has, with 'the', lower case, at most 24 characters; reads after 'rename' and 'name'.
phrases: the quiet end of the pond

frames.frame: Hang {hats} where the timetable hangs. The timetable gets the peg.
frames.subject: hats

frames.frame: Present the prize rosettes wearing {hats}. The growers agree it counts.
frames.subject: hats

frames.frame: Open the Quiet Competition in {hats}. Take it off before it rustles.
frames.subject: hats

frames.frame: The Anglers ask for a sign by {sign-places}: QUIET PLEASE, FISH THINKING.
frames.subject: signage

frames.frame: Lend the bandstand to the Guild's hat show. The tuba can model {hats}.
frames.subject: bandstands

frames.frame: A portrait of you in {hats}. Then one of the hat, on its own.
frames.subject: portraits

frames.frame: Clip the hedge by the kite field into {hats}. Kites will land in the brim.
frames.subject: hedges

frames.frame: Sit at the back of the band in {hats}. You may hold the music stand.
frames.subject: bandstands

frames.frame: Swap the hat poster by {sign-places} for the 7:02 timetable. Fewer hats.
frames.subject: buses

frames.frame: A sign by {sign-places}: WINDOWS AHEAD. NOSES BACK, PLEASE.
frames.subject: signage

frames.frame: Make the sign by {sign-places} say POND. At present it says BANDSTAND.
frames.subject: signage

frames.frame: Order {hats} for every clerk, with your name inside. Pruella's is for lunch.
frames.subject: vanity

frames.frame: The Guild says {harmless-complaints}. It needs the spotters' bench, to think it over.
frames.subject: paperwork

frames.frame: Launch the first kite in {hats}. Philomena will hold the hat on.
frames.subject: kites

frames.frame: The spotters say {harmless-complaints}. They want a bench by the leeks, to log it from.
frames.subject: buses

frames.frame: The growers will pay for a sign by {sign-places}: PUMPKINS FIRST. SHOPS AFTER.
frames.subject: signage

frames.frame: The growers say {harmless-complaints}, and ask for the Anglers' pond for the afternoon.
frames.subject: gardens

frames.frame: An inquiry into whether {hats} is a hat. Spotters to log every hat seen.
frames.subject: hats
frames.note: biggerStudy: The hat inquiry needs a second year. Several hats were logged twice.

frames.frame: The League says {harmless-complaints}. It asks for a windsock on the hedge, to check.
frames.subject: kites

frames.frame: The Guild will pay to dress the hedge show in {hats}. One per hedge.
frames.subject: hats

frames.frame: The Committee says {harmless-complaints}. It asks for a gazebo on the kite field, to recover in.
frames.subject: hedges

frames.frame: Pose pointing at the Guild's new sign by {sign-places}. It points back.
frames.subject: signage

frames.frame: Move the spotters' bench {odd-units} back from the windows. It is the noses.
frames.subject: buses

frames.frame: A sign by {sign-places}: CONCERT THIS WAY. CARRY ON UNTIL LOUD.
frames.subject: signage

frames.frame: Hang your portrait higher by {odd-units}. Rodney says it should look down on things.
frames.subject: portraits

frames.frame: A working group on whether a sign by {sign-places} can be played. The tuba thinks so.
frames.subject: signage
frames.note: biggerStudy: The working group has played the sign. It asks to try a second sign, louder.

frames.frame: Widen the bus shelter by the canal by {odd-units}. The Anglers can step round it.
frames.subject: buses

frames.frame: Issue the band with {hats}. The Anglers find a brim cuts noise by 9 %.
frames.subject: hats

frames.frame: Stand the band {odd-units} back from the bus stop. The 7:02 flinches.
frames.subject: buses

frames.frame: A study of the sign by {sign-places}: is it read, or only leant on?
frames.subject: signage
frames.note: biggerStudy: The sign study asks for a second sign beside it, to compare the leaning.

frames.frame: Lower the hedge by {odd-units}. Kites keep landing on it and asking for help.
frames.subject: hedges

frames.frame: The spotters will pay for a sign by {sign-places}: NO TUBAS BEFORE THE 7:02.
frames.subject: signage

frames.frame: Rename {things-to-rename} after the tuba. The Anglers had suggested nothing, quietly.
frames.subject: signage

frames.frame: Visit the growers, who say {harmless-complaints}. Nod gravely for the camera.
frames.subject: vegetable-shows

frames.frame: Name {things-to-rename} after you, says Pruella. And the café beside it after lunch.
frames.subject: vanity

frames.frame: The Anglers say {harmless-complaints}. They ask for a silent hut on the band's lawn.
frames.subject: paperwork

frames.frame: The band will hire the jetty to perform its complaint that {harmless-complaints}.
frames.subject: bandstands

frames.frame: Rename {things-to-rename} after the prize pumpkin. The band had hoped for its conductor.
frames.subject: signage

frames.frame: A sign by {sign-places}: KITES LANDING. HEDGES, LOOK AWAY.
frames.subject: signage

frames.frame: The Guild will pay to display its complaint that {harmless-complaints}. In the timetable case.
frames.subject: paperwork

frames.frame: The band's complaint that {harmless-complaints} is now a tune. Listen, and look moved.
frames.subject: bandstands

frames.frame: The League will pay to fly its complaint that {harmless-complaints} over the hedge show.
frames.subject: kites

frames.frame: The 7:02 was late by {odd-units} today. The spotters ask to wait in the hat shop.
frames.subject: buses

frames.frame: Raise the bandstand by {odd-units}. The music would carry further. Over the water.
frames.subject: bandstands

frames.frame: Put a launch mast on {things-to-rename} for the League. The hedge beside it needs a trim.
frames.subject: kites

frames.frame: Change the sign by {sign-places} from KITES WELCOME to KITES, PERHAPS NOT.
frames.subject: signage

frames.frame: A working group on claims that {harmless-complaints}. It will meet on the bandstand.
frames.subject: committees
frames.note: biggerStudy: The working group wants the bandstand on Sundays too. The claims keep coming.

frames.frame: The growers will hire {odd-units} of pavement outside the shops. To rest marrows on.
frames.subject: vegetable-shows

frames.frame: The Anglers will pay to move the music stands back by {odd-units}. Per stand.
frames.subject: bandstands

frames.frame: Trim the kite field back by {odd-units}. The hedge would like its edge back.
frames.subject: hedges

frames.frame: Unveil the spotters' name for {things-to-rename}. Pull slowly; they are timing you.
frames.subject: ceremonies

frames.frame: Rename {things-to-rename} for the hedge show. The League had asked first, by kite.
frames.subject: hedges

frames.frame: A working group to measure the high street in {odd-units}. Spotters hold the end.
frames.subject: committees
frames.note: biggerStudy: The measuring group has finished. It would like to measure again, the other way.

frames.frame: A study of exactly how far {odd-units} is. The growers will measure along the jetty.
frames.subject: committees
frames.note: biggerStudy: The study ran out of jetty. It asks for the canal path as well.

frames.frame: Rename {things-to-rename} after you. Rodney has ordered the signs, the maps and the mugs.
frames.subject: vanity

frames.frame: Till's Teas will pay to name {things-to-rename} after a tea. The growers had a marrow.
frames.subject: signage

frames.frame: Rename {things-to-rename} THE 7:02 VIEW. The Guild wanted WINDOW WALK.
frames.subject: signage

frames.frame: Announce the Anglers' new name for {things-to-rename}. Whisper it into a cupped hand.
frames.subject: ceremonies

frames.frame: The band will pay to rename {things-to-rename} in B flat. The spotters liked it unsung.
frames.subject: signage

frames.frame: Fit {things-to-rename} with a shop window. The League says kites will fly into it.
frames.subject: signage
